pages.text: The stream babbled along. A floating coconut shell made a boat and drifted away.
"Let's make boats tomorrow! One each, then we'll float them." "Okay!" They slapped their palms together.
Mumu got up early. So they could play as soon as Taro came, Mumu made both boats and put a leaf in each.
Taro arrived. Two boats sat side by side, with their leaves already in place.
Taro stood still. There was nothing left to make. His hands had nothing to do.
Mumu held out a boat. "This one's yours!" Taro did not take it.
Taro found another shell and sat on a stone. Without a word, he put a leaf into it.
Mumu watched. Taro's hands looked so happy. "Oh, making them was the fun part!"
Mumu found another shell and sat beside Taro. They put leaves into their boats together.
Now there were four boats. They floated them all in the stream. First one led, then another. They could not tell whose was whose.
